versions.changelog:
Introduces a LinkedIn repurposing skill that turns existing content into native posts, grounded in the user’s Taplio profile.

- Identifies one strongest takeaway, removes source-specific formatting, and rewrites the hook and post for LinkedIn.
- Produces a source takeaway, an 80–200-word post, and notes on what changed.
- Requires the Taplio MCP: checks the user’s profile and saves each post as a draft.
- Offers to schedule drafts across the week; publishing requires explicit confirmation.
